brand.hero_subtitle: Model releases, research breakthroughs, and industry moves — and what they actually mean for builders and businesses.

editorial.publication_description: a sharp, technically-literate AI intelligence publication covering model releases, research breakthroughs, industry moves, and what they actually mean for builders and businesses
rating_criteria: AI Relevance (1-10): Is this genuinely about AI/ML — model releases, research, tooling, industry moves, policy, or safety? (Not generic tech or crypto.)
Novelty & Significance (1-10): Is this a real breakthrough, major release, or meaningful development? (Or is it hype, a rehash, or a thin press release?)
Technical Credibility (1-10): Is it from a credible lab, researcher, or outlet — with substance over speculation?
editorial.research_focus: breaking AI/ML development — model or product launches, benchmark results, research findings, funding and industry moves, and the key labs and researchers involved (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, Mistral, and academia)
editorial.image_style: Prefer: sleek data-center hardware, abstract neural-network and circuit visualizations, humanoid robotics, glowing server racks, futuristic UI screens, researchers at workstations. Avoid literal text, logos, or watermarks.
